goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 12 Market Street, city Springfield, ZIP 62701, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone 555 010 0199. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The shopper said it reached payment, but no payment form was found.

findings.problem: After clicking a product link the tree still showed the home page; I had to read again to see the product page, with no clear sign the page had changed.
Add to bag gave no confirmation message; only the button briefly said Adding... and the cart button label changed to 1 1 item in cart, view bag (number repeated).

Form fields changed names after the country loaded (Street address(optional) became Street address, Postal code became Zip code, State/Province textbox became State dropdown), so my first fill failed.
Optional labels are doubled in accessible names, e.g. Phone (optional)(optional), and the Email address field has no visible-label text in the tree.

Phone 555 010 0199 and +1 555 010 0199 were both rejected as not a valid phone number; the error paragraph was not tied to the field, and Continue to shipping silently did nothing until I reread. I had to clear the optional phone to proceed.
Progress after Continue was shown only by a disabled Saving... button and a page-title change; no status announcement of success or failure.

Payment step shows No payment gateway configured and the Pay $36.19 button is disabled, so a real customer could not pay; no payment form (card fields) exists. Shipping cost of 34.20 also jumped the total from 1.99 to 36.19 despite a Free delivery banner.

findings.problem: After clicking a product link the tree still showed the home page; I had to read again to see the product page, with no clear sign the page had changed.
Add to bag gave no confirmation message; only the button briefly said Adding... and the cart button label changed to 1 1 item in cart, view bag (number repeated).

Form fields changed names after the country loaded (Street address(optional) became Street address, Postal code became Zip code, State/Province textbox became State dropdown), so my first fill failed.
Optional labels are doubled in accessible names, e.g. Phone (optional)(optional), and the Email address field has no visible-label text in the tree.

Phone 555 010 0199 and +1 555 010 0199 were both rejected as not a valid phone number; the error paragraph was not tied to the field, and Continue to shipping silently did nothing until I reread. I had to clear the optional phone to proceed.
Progress after Continue was shown only by a disabled Saving... button and a page-title change; no status announcement of success or failure.

Payment step shows No payment gateway configured and the Pay $36.19 button is disabled, so a real customer could not pay; no payment form (card fields) exists. Shipping cost of 34.20 also jumped the total from 1.99 to 36.19 despite a Free delivery banner.
